description: BROKEN (fractional guard): the execution amount_minor is a GENUINE fractional number (500.5), not an integer-valued float. A minor-unit amount must be a whole integer; a fractional value canonicalizes to a distinct reference and is not a valid amount. recurring_cap must reject it fail-closed in BOTH implementations (Node via Number.isInteger(500.5) === false, Python via _pos_intish rejecting a non-integer-valued float). This guards the opposite edge from recurr-float-amount: integer-valued floats are accepted, truly fractional amounts are not.
